title: Link two screens in a prototype
summary: Copy a screen and link the two with an On click interaction.

steps.say: Select the Home frame and press Control D to make a copy.

check.prompt: Are there two frames on the canvas, the Home frame and a copy?

hints: Click the Home name in the layers list to select the whole frame.
Drag the copy to the side if it covers the original.
steps.why: A prototype needs at least two screens to move between.

steps.say: Rename the copy to Details in the layers list.

check.prompt: Is there a frame named Details in the layers list?

hints: Double-click the name to edit it.
Control R renames the selected layer too.
steps.why: Clear names make the link destination obvious.

steps.say: Press Shift E to open the Prototype tab on the right.

checks.prompt: Is the Prototype tab active in the right sidebar?

hints: The tab sits next to Design at the top of the right sidebar.
Click the word Prototype if the shortcut does nothing.
steps.why: Links between screens are made in the Prototype tab.

steps.say: On the Home frame, click the text or shape people should tap.

check.prompt: Is a layer inside the Home frame selected, with a small circle on its edge?

hints: Double-click to reach a layer nested inside the frame.
Pick the layers list row if the canvas keeps selecting the frame.
steps.why: The tapped element is where the link starts.

steps.say: Drag the circle on its edge onto the Details frame and let go.

check.prompt: Is there an arrow linking the selected layer to the Details frame?

hints: The circle shows a plus sign when you hover over the selected layer's edge.
The panel should then read On click, Navigate to Details.
steps.why: On click, Navigate to is the most common prototype link.

steps.say: Press Shift Space to preview, then click the linked layer.

checks.prompt: Is a prototype preview showing the Home or Details screen?

hints: The play button at the top of the right sidebar, called Present, also runs it.
Press Escape to close the preview.
steps.why: Testing the link shows the flow the way users will see it.
